## Empowering a sustainable future for our planet

Agilent supports more than 285,000 laboratories across 110 countries—advancing scientific discovery
and innovation on a global scale.

The Agilent Foundation partners with organizations that advance STEM education, promote global
wellbeing, and build climate resilience.

Agilent is advancing science with purpose—embedding circular economy principles to drive sustainable
innovation and long-term impact.

Agilent is deepening its collaboration with My Green Lab as a top-tier Transformative Sponsor, while
expanding our portfolio of ACT-labeled products to support more sustainable science.

## Expert Genomics & Quality Solutions

### Who are we

BaseClear is a genomics and quality solutions partner based in Leiden, the Netherlands, serving the
biopharma, biotech, food, feed, and life sciences industries. We specialize in microbial, viral, and
mammalian cell analysis, combining advanced sequencing technologies, dPCR, bioinformatics, and
GMP-compliant quality testing to support both research and regulated environments.

### Why us

What sets BaseClear apart is the combination of scientific expertise, in-house bioinformatics,
regulatory understanding, and fast, reliable execution. From contamination testing, strain
verification, and dPCR quantification to viral safety testing and sequencing workflows, we help
customers generate high-quality data, reduce risk, and accelerate product development and release.
Our ISO 17025 and ISO 27001 certifications, together with our GMP license, reflect our commitment to
quality, data security, and regulatory compliance.

BaseClear is known for its customer-centric and highly personalized approach. Clients work directly
with dedicated project managers and scientific experts, ensuring clear communication, fast support,
and tailored solutions throughout every project. Whether it is coordinating complex studies,
arranging sample pick-up, or providing hands-on guidance, our team is always accessible and focused
on making collaboration easy and efficient.

### Who we work with

Our clients range from emerging biotech companies to global biopharma, food, feed, and ingredient
manufacturers, as well as academic and research organizations. They rely on BaseClear as a trusted
partner for genomics, quality control, regulatory support, and complex analytical challenges.

## What our clients say

### Anders Damholt

### Head of Clinical Development

We have been using BaseClear service for biomarker analysis related to a clinical trial, where we
tested a probiotic product in pregnant females and infant children.

These included microbiome analysis by sequencing and qPCR analysis, cytokine analysis and
metabolomics, on a large variety of samples. We furthermore received bioinformatics reports from
BaseClear.

Due to the timely and high-quality service delivered by BaseClear, we were able to conduct a
clinical trial, that was conclusive as well as successful. We highly appreciate the collaboration
with BaseClear. Thank you, BaseClear!

### Robert Rissman

### Research Director of Dermatology

We discuss the study design together. BaseClear thinks along with us how our research questions can
be answered, and which analysis techniques are the most appropriate ones in each case.

We appreciate that BaseClear offers a tailored approach, where its staff members are always alert to
new aspects and developments that should be considered. It is really important to do this at the
study design stage.

### Head of Clinical Development

We have implemented the MicroSEQ® system within Teva whereby we commissioned BaseClear as back up
and expert laboratory. This means that we can use their services if we need extra capacity or a more
extensive identification method in the event MicroSEQ® does not satisfy the requirements.

Since we are GMP certified, I first had to perform an audit at BaseClear. We were really quite
impressed by what we saw. Everything was meticulously organised. The entire workflow was well
documented. We were able to check all the controls and trace them easily in the computer. BaseClear
more than qualified for us to be able to outsource materials to them.

### Microbiological specialist

For our vaccine production it is important to check for microbiological contamination and to
subsequent identify these on the basis of its DNA. BaseClear does excellent work and always sticks
to the agreements made.

They also deliver additional services. If for example, an alignment has to be made between a number
of specific microorganisms that have already been analysed before. I always receive a response
within an hour.

clinical trial, that was conclusive as well as successful. We highly appreciate the collaboration
with BaseClear. Thank you, BaseClear!

### Robert Rissman

### Research Director of Dermatology

We discuss the study design together. BaseClear thinks along with us how our research questions can
be answered, and which analysis techniques are the most appropriate ones in each case.

We appreciate that BaseClear offers a tailored approach, where its staff members are always alert to
new aspects and developments that should be considered. It is really important to do this at the
study design stage.

### Head of Clinical Development

We have implemented the MicroSEQ® system within Teva whereby we commissioned BaseClear as back up
and expert laboratory. This means that we can use their services if we need extra capacity or a more
extensive identification method in the event MicroSEQ® does not satisfy the requirements.

Since we are GMP certified, I first had to perform an audit at BaseClear. We were really quite
impressed by what we saw. Everything was meticulously organised. The entire workflow was well
documented. We were able to check all the controls and trace them easily in the computer. BaseClear
more than qualified for us to be able to outsource materials to them.

### Microbiological specialist

For our vaccine production it is important to check for microbiological contamination and to
subsequent identify these on the basis of its DNA. BaseClear does excellent work and always sticks
to the agreements made.

They also deliver additional services. If for example, an alignment has to be made between a number
of specific microorganisms that have already been analysed before. I always receive a response
within an hour.

## Talk to an Expert

Schedule a free consultation with our experts to discuss your testing needs and regulatory
requirements. We’ll help design a compliant testing workflow for your project.

[ Book your free consultation ][114]

## Application Workflow Overview

### Ultima High Throughput Sequencing

BaseClear’s Ultima platform delivers ultra-high-throughput sequencing for projects that require
large-scale genomic analysis, exceptional data volumes, and cost-efficient sequencing at scale.
Powered by the Ultima Genomics UG200 platform and supported by automated library preparation,
advanced bioinformatics, and dedicated scientific expertise, clients benefit from high-quality
sequencing data, scalable project execution, and a future-ready solution for applications such as
whole genome sequencing, population genomics, single cell, transcriptomics, metagenomics, and large
research initiatives.

innovations that transform the way the world sees the genome.

## Moving Health Forward Together

At Bionano, we strive to elevate health and wellness for all people through customer-centered
innovations that transform the way the world sees the genome.

##### THE VARIATION PROBLEM

### Reframing Our View

The inability to resolve the continuum of genomic variation—from single nucleotide variants (SNVs)
to structural variants (SVs) up to chromosome-arm scale—is holding us back from comprehensive
disease identification and treatment.

Tools such as karyotyping, FISH and chromosomal microarray (CMA) lack the digital resolution and
efficiency to resolve SVs at scale. Next-generation sequencing (NGS) struggles with larger
structural variants and highly repetitive regions of the genome.

Bionano optical genome mapping (OGM) solutions address this critical gap.

Back
Next

##### PIONEERING INNOVATIONS FOR PROGRESS

### Pioneering Innovations for Progress

Bionano OGM solutions provide the essential tools clinicians and researchers need to reveal
actionable insights from all classes of genomic variation.
* Bionano OGM Mapping Systems—Provide the data other tools miss with digital precision in a rapid,
  highly automated workflow from sample preparation through primary data analysis.
* Bionano Analysis Software—Brings OGM data together with NGS, CMA and other data types in one view
  for truly comprehensive interpretation and analysis of variant data.

Our solutions are backed by a support team dedicated to empowering you to move forward.

Back
Next

##### TRANSFORMATIONAL IMPACT

### Reveal Variation That Matters

OGM users worldwide are making breakthroughs across a wide range of disease states. Over 500
publications cite OGM solutions, and that number is quickly climbing.

Our customers’ discoveries in cancer and genetic disease reveal the variations responsible for
deleterious effects as well as new druggable targets hidden from view until now.

Together, we are moving health and hope forward for patients and their families forward.

Back
Next

##### MEET THE NEEDS

### Focus Areas and Applications

Our OGM systems, software solutions and uncompromising support allow you to reveal more genomic
variation that matters across a variety of applications in clinical care, research and therapeutics.

#### Oncology

Solve the complex biology of hematological malignancies and solid tumors by revealing structural
variants traditional methods miss and create new opportunities for personalized care.

[Learn More][60]

#### Genetic Disease

See chromosomal aberrations with digital clarity and deliver new answers for reproductive health
issues, neurodevelopmental delay and rare disease.

[Learn More][61]

#### Cell Bioprocessing

Enhance your quality control and ensure the genomic integrity and stability of cell lines for
producer cell lines, research cell lines and cell therapy applications.

[Learn More][62]

#### Cytogenomics

Transform your laboratory workflow and detect all classes of chromosomal aberrations in cancer and
genetic disease cases with digital precision.

[Learn More][63]

The Saphyr system provides genome-wide detection and analysis of all classes of structural variants
from ultra-high molecular weight DNA using OGM.

Bionano's VIA is the only analysis software that receives and interprets data from optical genome

system require just a few minutes of hands-on time per sample.

## Moving Health Forward Together

At Bionano, we strive to elevate health and wellness for all people through customer-centered
innovations that transform the way the world sees the genome.

##### THE VARIATION PROBLEM

### Reframing Our View

The inability to resolve the continuum of genomic variation—from single nucleotide variants (SNVs)
to structural variants (SVs) up to chromosome-arm scale—is holding us back from comprehensive
disease identification and treatment.

Tools such as karyotyping, FISH and chromosomal microarray (CMA) lack the digital resolution and
efficiency to resolve SVs at scale. Next-generation sequencing (NGS) struggles with larger
structural variants and highly repetitive regions of the genome.

Bionano optical genome mapping (OGM) solutions address this critical gap.

Back
Next

##### PIONEERING INNOVATIONS FOR PROGRESS

### Pioneering Innovations for Progress

Bionano OGM solutions provide the essential tools clinicians and researchers need to reveal
actionable insights from all classes of genomic variation.
* Bionano OGM Mapping Systems—Provide the data other tools miss with digital precision in a rapid,
  highly automated workflow from sample preparation through primary data analysis.
* Bionano Analysis Software—Brings OGM data together with NGS, CMA and other data types in one view
  for truly comprehensive interpretation and analysis of variant data.

Our solutions are backed by a support team dedicated to empowering you to move forward.

Back
Next

##### TRANSFORMATIONAL IMPACT

### Reveal Variation That Matters

OGM users worldwide are making breakthroughs across a wide range of disease states. Over 500
publications cite OGM solutions, and that number is quickly climbing.

Our customers’ discoveries in cancer and genetic disease reveal the variations responsible for
deleterious effects as well as new druggable targets hidden from view until now.

Together, we are moving health and hope forward for patients and their families forward.

Back
Next

##### MEET THE NEEDS

### Focus Areas and Applications

Our OGM systems, software solutions and uncompromising support allow you to reveal more genomic
variation that matters across a variety of applications in clinical care, research and therapeutics.

#### Oncology

Solve the complex biology of hematological malignancies and solid tumors by revealing structural
variants traditional methods miss and create new opportunities for personalized care.

[Learn More][60]

#### Genetic Disease

See chromosomal aberrations with digital clarity and deliver new answers for reproductive health
issues, neurodevelopmental delay and rare disease.

[Learn More][61]

#### Cell Bioprocessing

Enhance your quality control and ensure the genomic integrity and stability of cell lines for
producer cell lines, research cell lines and cell therapy applications.

[Learn More][62]

#### Cytogenomics

Transform your laboratory workflow and detect all classes of chromosomal aberrations in cancer and
genetic disease cases with digital precision.

[Learn More][63]

#### Molecular Genomics

Achieve more comprehensive structural variant profiles than sequencing alone provides and maximize
pathogenic findings in your cancer and genetic disease cases.

[Learn More][64]

### Make An Impact

Join the growing community of Bionano users worldwide who are moving healthcare and hope forward
with our solutions. Watch their stories and learn how Bionano OGM systems and software solutions can
help you break through.

##### FEATURED STORIES

#### OGM Makes A Huge Impact On Clinical Research


Sign up to watch this webinar and hear how OGM makes a huge impact on clinical research, as Dr.
Rashmi Kanagal-Shamanna and Dr. Guillermo Garcia-Manero (MD Anderson Cancer Center) discuss OGM for
Enhanced Characterization of Myelodysplastic Syndromes.

[Learn More][65]

##### FEATURED STORIES

#### Dr. Wallace’s Breakthrough

[Learn More][66]

##### Our Products

### Stratys^{™} System

Reveal all classes of structural variants and leave the limits of traditional cytogenetics and
sequencing behind with OGM and the Stratys System.

[Learn More][67]

### Saphyr^{®} System

The Saphyr system provides genome-wide detection and analysis of all classes of structural variants
from ultra-high molecular weight DNA using OGM.

[Learn More][68]

### Analysis Software

Bionano's VIA is the only analysis software that receives and interprets data from optical genome
mapping (OGM), next-generation sequencing (NGS) and microarrays to contextualize all classes of
genomic variation and drive meaningful insights.

[Learn More][69]

### Ionic^{®} Purification System

The Ionic system uses isotachophoresis (ITP) to isolate, purify, and concentrate genomic DNA and RNA
from cells, tissue, and FFPE samples with Ionic G2 chemistry. DNA and RNA samples prepared by the
system require just a few minutes of hands-on time per sample.

[Learn More][70]

ACMG attracts medical and scientific leaders from around the world who are working to apply research

conditions and rare and common diseases in patients in the clinical setting.

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals

  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

# The Most Reliable Way to Order NGS Services from Top Providers.

#### One-stop shop for NGS services

Quickly find next-generation sequencing and bioinformatics services from our network of over 100
partnering providers. Our experienced NGS specialists help you along the way to find the right
service for your project. We offer free scientific consultation to help define your project.

#### Order with peace of mind

All Genohub projects are covered by our quality and turnaround time guarantees. We actively
supervise your project and help resolve any issues quickly. Providers perform better when Genohub
has your back and they don't get paid until the project is completed to your satisfaction.

#### Track and manage your projects

Our secure online project management tools allow you and your collaborators to easily accept quotes,
track your project, communicate with the provider and share files. All your project-related
information is protected by our strict confidentiality policy.

#### One relationship

When you use Genohub you get access to our curated network of top NGS service providers, while your
organization only has to deal with a single vendor for service terms and payments. Most institutions
prefer working with one CRO to reduce purchase order paperwork. With Genohub you can do that without
limiting your choices.

#### Data storage and transfer

At no extra cost, each Genohub project includes:

- Unlimited storage all project data for 3 months
- Fast, secure and reliable data transfer
- Private project bucket with secure access keys

#### Fast response times

When you submit a request or ask us a question our typical response time is less than 2 hours. Once
your project specifications are confirmed we can typically get you instant estimates and a confirmed
quote in less than 24 hours. We actively follow-up with our partners to make sure you always get a
fast response

[#404 Male Breast Cancer with X-Men Actor and Former Pro Wrestler Tyler Mane]

4 days ago

### [#404 Male Breast Cancer with X-Men Actor and Former Pro Wrestler Tyler Mane][18]

4 days ago

4 days ago

21 min

What happens when someone known for strength, stature, and intimidating roles faces a diagnosis most
people do not associate with men?
 
Tyler Mane is known for playing Sabretooth in X-Men and Deadpool & Wolverine, Michael Myers in
Halloween, and Ajax in Troy. Before his acting career, Tyler spent more than a decade wrestling
professionally around the world, including appearances with WCW and UWF as Big Sky and Nitron.
Recently, Tyler has taken on a very different role: raising awareness about male breast cancer.
 
Tyler joins host Kira Dineen to share his experience of discovering a breast lump, initially
believing it was a lipoma, having his concerns dismissed, and ultimately receiving a breast cancer
diagnosis. He opens up about his first instinct to keep the diagnosis private, the embarrassment he
initially felt, and what motivated him to speak publicly.
Episode Discussion Topics
The breast lump that led Tyler to seek medical care
Why Tyler and his wife, Renae, initially believed the lump was a lipoma
Having his concerns dismissed and continuing to pursue answers
Tyler’s first reaction to his breast cancer diagnosis
The embarrassment and stigma surrounding male breast cancer
Why he ultimately decided to share his story publicly
Symptoms and physical changes men should pay attention to
How masculinity and “toughing it out” can delay medical care
The importance of self-advocacy and early detection
How cancer treatment differs from the physical demands of wrestling
Redefining strength during illness and recovery
Genetic counseling and germline genetic testing after a male breast cancer diagnosis
The implications of Tyler’s BRCA2+ genetic testing results for treatment and relatives including his
adult children 
How Tyler’s public image affects the response to his diagnosis
Tyler and Renae’s upcoming podcast, MANE AF
 
Resources & Links
Tyler Mane’s Breast Cancer Announcement Instagram Video
@TheRealTylerMane
@ManeAFpod
NCCN Patient Resources for Breast Cancer
NCCN patient resources are based on the same treatment information your doctors use and help you
talk to your doctor about the best treatment options for your disease.
National Cancer Institute: Breast Cancer in Men
The National Cancer Institute provides an overview of male breast cancer symptoms, diagnosis,
treatment, genetic testing, and questions patients may want to discuss with their healthcare teams.
The NCI notes that inherited variants in BRCA1, BRCA2, and other genes may influence treatment and
have implications for relatives.
Facing Our Risk of Cancer Empowered (FORCE)
FORCE provides education, peer support, advocacy, research updates, and resources for people and
families affected by inherited cancer risk, including BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2, ATM, CHEK2, and other
genes.
Find a Genetic Counselor
The National Society of Genetic Counselors’ (NSGC) directory can help patients locate a genetic
counselor

Genetic testing panels vary with how many genes are included. Healthcare providers can order just
one gene or around a hundred, and everything in between. Tyler mentioned his possibly including 85,

Relevant DNA Today Podcast Episode
#360 Hereditary Breast Cancer on the Big Screen with Love, Danielle
Actress and filmmaker Devin Sidell and hereditary cancer advocate Amy Byer Shainman discuss the film
Love, Danielle, Devin’s experience with a BRCA1 pathogenic variant, hereditary breast cancer,
preventive surgery, family communication, and using storytelling to increase awareness.
#364 Breast Cancer Genetic Testing in Italy: A Curated Gene Panel
This episode explores hereditary breast cancer testing, the genes included on breast cancer panels,
and how researchers evaluate which genes have sufficient evidence to guide clinical care.
#159 Black Cancer Genes on Breast Cancer
Attorney and BRCA advocate Erika Stallings and genetic counselor Dena Goldberg discuss breast cancer
genetics, BRCA1 and BRCA2, racial disparities in cancer genetics, and improving access to genetic
counseling and testing in the Black community.
#165 Sequencing for Cancer Risk with Sandra Balladares
Scientist and breast cancer survivor Dr. Sandra Balladares shares her experience with breast cancer
and discusses how genomic sequencing can identify inherited cancer risk, particularly within
historically underserved populations.
#81 Irina Brooke on BRCA2
Patient advocate Irina Brooke shares her BRCA2 journey, including genetic counseling, genetic
testing, cancer-risk management, and supporting people and families affected by hereditary cancer.
#25 Hereditary Cancer Syndromes with Ellen Matloff and Amy Byer Shainman
Hereditary cancer experts Ellen Matloff and Amy Byer Shainman discuss BRCA-associated cancer risks,
genetic counseling, genetic testing, breast and ovarian cancer, and the documentary Pink & Blue,
which includes the experiences of men affected by breast cancer.

### [#403 Genetic Counseling Boards Prep: ABGC’s New Resources][21]

Jul 17, 2026

Jul 17, 2026

30 min

Preparing for the genetic counseling board exam can feel overwhelming. Between the extensive study
materials, challenging practice questions, and uncertainty about what to expect on exam day,
candidates often struggle to determine where to begin and how to use their preparation time
effectively.
In this episode of DNA Today, host Kira Dineen is joined by Melanie Hardy and Amy Shikany to explore
the new and updated resources available to candidates preparing for the American Board of Genetic
Counseling (ABGC) Certification Examination.
Melanie Hardy is the 2026 President of ABGC, and Amy Shikany is ABGC President-Elect and a past
Chair of the Certification and Education Committee.
Together, they discuss ABGC’s Certify webpage, the new CGC self-study guide, the approved references
list, a new student webinar, and the updated practice examination that launched on June 15, 2026.
They also take listeners behind the scenes of how the certification exam is developed, reviewed, and
maintained.
 
Discussion Topics:
What the ABGC Certification Examination is designed to assess
Where candidates should begin when navigating ABGC’s certification and exam resources
How to use the exam content outline when developing a study plan
Why ABGC created its new CGC self-study guide
How candidates can use the self-study guide alongside the approved references
What candidates can expect from ABGC’s new student webinar
How questions for the certification exam are written and reviewed
What makes a strong “one best answer” board-exam question
How ABGC evaluates questions for accuracy, relevance, fairness, and justice, equity, diversity, and
inclusion considerations
What has changed in the updated ABGC practice examination
How closely the practice exam reflects the structure and reasoning required on the certification
exam
How candidates should interpret their practice-exam results
How the passing standard for the certification exam is determined
Preparation steps candidates should take before exam day
Encouragement and next steps for candidates who do not pass on their first attempt
How certified genetic counselors can contribute to the development and maintenance of the
examination
One clarification from the conversation: candidates are provided access to a simple calculator
during the certification exam.
 
About the Guests
Melanie Hardy, MS, CGC is the 2026 President of the American Board of Genetic Counseling. Through
her leadership with ABGC, she supports the organization’s work to establish and maintain
certification standards for the genetic counseling profession and provide resources for current and
future certified genetic counselors.
 
Amy Shikany, MS, CGC is President-Elect of the American Board of Genetic Counseling and a past Chair
of ABGC’s Certification and Education Committee. Her work with ABGC has included supporting the
development, review, and ongoing maintenance of the genetic counseling certification examination.

### [#404 Male Breast Cancer with X-Men Actor and Former Pro Wrestler Tyler Mane][18]

4 days ago

4 days ago

21 min

What happens when someone known for strength, stature, and intimidating roles faces a diagnosis most
people do not associate with men?
 
Tyler Mane is known for playing Sabretooth in X-Men and Deadpool & Wolverine, Michael Myers in
Halloween, and Ajax in Troy. Before his acting career, Tyler spent more than a decade wrestling
professionally around the world, including appearances with WCW and UWF as Big Sky and Nitron.
Recently, Tyler has taken on a very different role: raising awareness about male breast cancer.
 
Tyler joins host Kira Dineen to share his experience of discovering a breast lump, initially
believing it was a lipoma, having his concerns dismissed, and ultimately receiving a breast cancer
diagnosis. He opens up about his first instinct to keep the diagnosis private, the embarrassment he
initially felt, and what motivated him to speak publicly.
Episode Discussion Topics
The breast lump that led Tyler to seek medical care
Why Tyler and his wife, Renae, initially believed the lump was a lipoma
Having his concerns dismissed and continuing to pursue answers
Tyler’s first reaction to his breast cancer diagnosis
The embarrassment and stigma surrounding male breast cancer
Why he ultimately decided to share his story publicly
Symptoms and physical changes men should pay attention to
How masculinity and “toughing it out” can delay medical care
The importance of self-advocacy and early detection
How cancer treatment differs from the physical demands of wrestling
Redefining strength during illness and recovery
Genetic counseling and germline genetic testing after a male breast cancer diagnosis
The implications of Tyler’s BRCA2+ genetic testing results for treatment and relatives including his
adult children 
How Tyler’s public image affects the response to his diagnosis
Tyler and Renae’s upcoming podcast, MANE AF

NCCN Patient Resources for Breast Cancer
NCCN patient resources are based on the same treatment information your doctors use and help you
talk to your doctor about the best treatment options for your disease.
National Cancer Institute: Breast Cancer in Men
The National Cancer Institute provides an overview of male breast cancer symptoms, diagnosis,
treatment, genetic testing, and questions patients may want to discuss with their healthcare teams.
The NCI notes that inherited variants in BRCA1, BRCA2, and other genes may influence treatment and
have implications for relatives.
Facing Our Risk of Cancer Empowered (FORCE)
FORCE provides education, peer support, advocacy, research updates, and resources for people and
families affected by inherited cancer risk, including BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2, ATM, CHEK2, and other
genes.

The National Society of Genetic Counselors’ (NSGC) directory can help patients locate a genetic
counselor

Relevant DNA Today Podcast Episode
#360 Hereditary Breast Cancer on the Big Screen with Love, Danielle
Actress and filmmaker Devin Sidell and hereditary cancer advocate Amy Byer Shainman discuss the film
Love, Danielle, Devin’s experience with a BRCA1 pathogenic variant, hereditary breast cancer,
preventive surgery, family communication, and using storytelling to increase awareness.
#364 Breast Cancer Genetic Testing in Italy: A Curated Gene Panel
This episode explores hereditary breast cancer testing, the genes included on breast cancer panels,
and how researchers evaluate which genes have sufficient evidence to guide clinical care.
#159 Black Cancer Genes on Breast Cancer
Attorney and BRCA advocate Erika Stallings and genetic counselor Dena Goldberg discuss breast cancer
genetics, BRCA1 and BRCA2, racial disparities in cancer genetics, and improving access to genetic
counseling and testing in the Black community.
#165 Sequencing for Cancer Risk with Sandra Balladares
Scientist and breast cancer survivor Dr. Sandra Balladares shares her experience with breast cancer
and discusses how genomic sequencing can identify inherited cancer risk, particularly within
historically underserved populations.
#81 Irina Brooke on BRCA2
Patient advocate Irina Brooke shares her BRCA2 journey, including genetic counseling, genetic
testing, cancer-risk management, and supporting people and families affected by hereditary cancer.
#25 Hereditary Cancer Syndromes with Ellen Matloff and Amy Byer Shainman
Hereditary cancer experts Ellen Matloff and Amy Byer Shainman discuss BRCA-associated cancer risks,
genetic counseling, genetic testing, breast and ovarian cancer, and the documentary Pink & Blue,
which includes the experiences of men affected by breast cancer.

# Welcome to Mercia

Powering ambition in the UK region by region

## Mercia targets up to £500m for UK Real Estate Development Fund

Mercia Asset Management PLC is seeking commitments for up to £500million for its UK Real Estate
Development Debt Fund, providing institutional investors with access to a specialist private credit
strategy focused on UK industrial and logistics developments.

The fund will provide senior secured lending to experienced developers, with all investments
benefiting from first-charge security and a disciplined underwriting framework.

The strategy is managed by Frontier Development Capital (FDC), part of Mercia Asset Management.

[ Learn more about the Real Estate Development Fund ][89]

## Mercia announces its Annual Report & Accounts 2026

Mercia Asset Management PLC is pleased to announce the release of its Annual Report & Accounts 2026.

 

 

[ Read a copy here ][90]

## Mercia empowers UK businesses to innovate and grow, forging long-term partnerships

Fuelling UK business ambitions, we provide venture capital, business loans and private equity
ranging from £100k to £10m to accelerate growth and impact. Our mission is to be the first-choice
provider of capital for businesses that typically seek up to £10million. We strive to be a
responsible long-term investment partner, pledging far more than capital when we invest in your
business.

## Looking for investment?

# How to Play Daily Jumble: The Complete Guide

Daily Jumble (also known as Jumble or Word Scramble) has been challenging newspaper readers for
decades with its unique blend of word puzzles and clever punchlines. This beloved word game
exercises vocabulary skills while delivering a dose of humor through its cartoon punchlines. Whether
you're new to the game or looking to improve your solving skills, this comprehensive guide will help
you master the Daily Jumble puzzle.

## What Is Daily Jumble?

Daily Jumble is a word puzzle that typically appears in newspapers and online gaming platforms. The
game consists of scrambled words that players must unscramble, followed by a cartoon and a final
jumbled answer related to the cartoon's content. The final solution typically contains a pun or play
on words that ties everything together.

## The Components of a Daily Jumble Puzzle

A standard Daily Jumble puzzle contains:
1. **Four scrambled words** - Each word's letters are rearranged randomly
2. **Circled letters** - After unscrambling each word, specific letters are circled
3. **A cartoon with a caption** - Usually containing a clue about the final solution
4. **The final answer spaces** - Where the circled letters, once rearranged, form the punchline

## Step-by-Step Guide to Playing Daily Jumble

### Step 1: Unscramble the Four Words

Begin by looking at each scrambled word. These jumbled arrangements typically contain 4-7 letters.
Your goal is to rearrange the letters to form common English words.

**Tips for unscrambling words:**
* Look for common letter combinations (TH, CH, ING, ED)
* Identify vowels and try positioning them
* Consider letter patterns that frequently appear in English words
* Try different arrangements until a recognizable word emerges

### Step 2: Note the Circled Letters

As you solve each scrambled word, pay attention to the circled letters. These will be used to solve
the final jumble. Write down these circled letters in the order they appear in the unscrambled
words.

### Step 3: Study the Cartoon and Caption

The cartoon and its accompanying caption provide critical context for the final solution. They often
contain:
* Visual clues related to the theme
* A play on words indicated by quotation marks
* A scenario that sets up the punchline

### Step 4: Solve the Final Jumble

Using the circled letters you've collected from the four unscrambled words, rearrange them to form
the answer that completes the cartoon's caption. This final answer is usually a pun or witty phrase
that relates directly to the cartoon's scenario.

The answer spaces often indicate:
* How many words are in the final solution
* How many letters are in each word

## Strategies for Daily Jumble Success

### For Beginners:
1. **Start with shorter words** - They're usually easier to unscramble
2. **Say the letters aloud** - Sometimes hearing the sounds helps recognize patterns
3. **Write the letters in a circle** - This can help you see different arrangements
4. **Don't be afraid to skip and return** - If one word is giving you trouble, move to the next

### For Advanced Players:
1. **Learn common prefixes and suffixes** - Recognizing these can speed up solving
2. **Build your vocabulary** - The more words you know, the faster you'll solve
3. **Practice anagramming** - Train your brain to see word possibilities in jumbled letters
4. **Develop pattern recognition** - With practice, you'll start seeing words within the jumble

## Common Word Patterns to Look For

When stuck on a jumbled word, look for these patterns:
* **Double letters** (EE, OO, TT)
* **Common endings** (-ING, -ED, -LY, -TION)
* **Consonant clusters** (STR, SPL, THR)
* **Vowel combinations** (EA, OU, IE)

virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational

### Military Health System Research Symposium (MHSRS) Conference 2026

MTEC will be attending MHSRS! This is the premier military or civilian meeting that focuses
specifically on the unique medical needs of the Warfighter. The event provides a collaborative
setting for the exchange of information between military providers with deployment experience,
research and academic scientists, international partners, and industry on research and related
health care initiatives falling under the topic areas of Combat Casualty Care, Military Operational
Medicine, Clinical and Rehabilitative Medicine, Information Sciences, Military Infectious Diseases,
and the Radiation Health Effects. Learn more at https://www.mhsrs.net/

August 3, 2026

in military health.

October 18, 2026

Meeting! This year celebrates a decade of collaboration, innovation, and partnership with our
Government partners and the broader MTEC community. Over two dynamic days, attendees will engage in
networking, knowledge sharing, and strategic discussions that advance military medical innovation.
This is your opportunity to connect directly with industry peers, government stakeholders, and
academic leaders shaping the future of medical technology. Please note: Registration is open to MTEC
members only. Membership is required to attend this event and participate fully in consortium
programs.

# Providing Clinicians and Patients Worldwide with Genetic Testing and Counseling Services

MGZ - Medical Genetics Center offers diagnostic genetic testing and counseling in many
subspecialties of human genetics. Our medical and scientific experts are available to work with you
to develop strategies for the diagnosis and care of your patients.

In MGZ's in-house, nationally accredited medical genetics lab, over 10,000 analyses are performed
each year and interpreted by both our clinical geneticists and our scientific team. Our diagnostic
services are available worldwide.

## WHY MGZ?

#### Our Expertise

Our specialized expertise in hereditary cancers, rare and complex diseases means clinicians have
premium diagnostic support to provide optimal patient care.

#### Comprehensive Test Menu

MGZ’s diverse selection of analyses in more than 12 clinical areas provides clinicians with valuable
time-saving advantages via a broad testing menu to meet various genetic testing needs.

#### Tiered Testing Strategies

Our tiered testing strategies ensure clinicians have access to optimal stepwise genetic testing
options - especially helpful in complex and challenging patient diagnoses.

#### Rapid & Reliable Turnaround Times

MGZ offers fast and reliable turnaround times, 3-6 weeks for most routine analyses, and 1-2 weeks
for fast track and prenatal testing.

#### Quality Through Accreditation

As a DAkkS-accredited laboratory, according to the DIN EN ISO 15189:2014 international standard, you
can be reassured of MGZ’s compliance with high quality standards.

#### Informative Reports

Detailed and informative test reports, in adherence to current ACMG guidelines and interpreted by
both MGZ’s medical and scientific teams, provide clinicians with meaningful results to assist with
patient management decisions.

#### Cost-Conscious Pricing

MGZ’s cost-conscious pricing strategy through tiered testing options facilitates effective cost
management for its clients.

#### Customer-Oriented Support

Our caring and knowledgeable support team is available to assist both patients and clinicians with
test requests, billing and payment-related questions, and general information to ensure a
customer-friendly experience.

[[Suzhou Nanomicro Technology Co., Ltd.]][54]

About Us

Established in Biobay, Suzhou in 2007, NanoMicro is the world leader in the manufacture of
spherical, mono-disperse particles utilizing our proprietary manufacturing processes which enable
high yield, cost effective production of such particles for a wide variety of industries and
applications. NanoMicro`s products cover a broad spectrum of applications including high performance
Chromatography Media, solid phase extraction (SPE) sorbents, Particle Size Standards,Magnetic
Particles, LCD Spacers, ACF Conductive Particles, and various other micro particles. Our
chromatography products are available in a variety of polymer formats with particle sizes from
analytical through to preparative scale. Our proprietary expertise in controlling particle
morphology and surface chemistry can be precisely tailored to optimize for solutes ranging from the
smallest API to large constructs such as viruses and viral vectors. A wide range of surface
chemistries is available from RPC/chiral for small molecules to ion exchange/affinity for
biomolecules. We manufacture mono-disperse particles of wide range of sizes. With more than 10
product lines and over 5000 products, we serve a variety of rapidly growing industry segments.
NanoMicro has two ISO 9001-certified manufacturing sites, one in Suzhou Industrial Park and another
in Changshu to ensure security of supply for our customers. Both facilities use the same well-
defined processes with production capacity of more than 200,000 Liter of resins and 24,000 kg of
silica products per year with batch sizes up to 1000 L or 200 kg. NanoMicro`s manufacturing and
quality system are available for customer audits. Additionally, our strong R&D and applications
teams ensure sustainable innovation and can provide custom solutions such as custom resin
development and purification process development.

About Us

Established in Biobay, Suzhou in 2007, NanoMicro is the world leader in the manufacture of
spherical, mono-disperse particles utilizing our proprietary manufacturing processes which enable
high yield, cost effective production of such particles for a wide variety of industries and
applications. NanoMicro`s products cover a broad spectrum of applications including high performance
Chromatography Media, solid phase extraction (SPE) sorbents, Particle Size Standards,Magnetic
Particles, LCD Spacers, ACF Conductive Particles, and various other micro particles. Our
chromatography products are available in a variety of polymer formats with particle sizes from
analytical through to preparative scale. Our proprietary expertise in controlling particle
morphology and surface chemistry can be precisely tailored to optimize for solutes ranging from the
smallest API to large constructs such as viruses and viral vectors. A wide range of surface
chemistries is available from RPC/chiral for small molecules to ion exchange/affinity for
biomolecules. We manufacture mono-disperse particles of wide range of sizes. With more than 10
product lines and over 5000 products, we serve a variety of rapidly growing industry segments.
NanoMicro has two ISO 9001-certified manufacturing sites, one in Suzhou Industrial Park and another
in Changshu to ensure security of supply for our customers. Both facilities use the same well-
defined processes with production capacity of more than 200,000 Liter of resins and 24,000 kg of
silica products per year with batch sizes up to 1000 L or 200 kg. NanoMicro`s manufacturing and
quality system are available for customer audits. Additionally, our strong R&D and applications
teams ensure sustainable innovation and can provide custom solutions such as custom resin
development and purification process development.

# Streamline Structural Variant Detection with Fast Genome Prep

A comprehensive solution for amplification-free DNA analysis, enabling researchers to progress from
sample to genome mapping on the OhmX Platform in a single day.

][36]
[[Electrify Your Stuctural Variant Analysis]

# Electrify Your Stuctural Variant Analysis

Structural variants (SVs) are the dominant form of genomic variation and make up over 1% of the
human genome. To fully realize the promise of genomics and improve human health, researchers and
clinicians must query and understand all forms of SVs.

][37]
[[Straightforward and cost-effective SV analysis]

# Straightforward and cost-effective SV analysis

The OhmX Analyzer is a simple benchtop solution designed to drive SV detection at the whole genome
level. With its low cost and minimal set-up requirements, researchers and scientists can now
conveniently access SV data, without compromising on sensitivity and accuracy.

][38]
[[Unrivaled resolution to uncover new insights]

# Unrivaled resolution to uncover new insights

Our state-of-the-art, electronic nano-detectors deliver the highest resolution for whole genome
structural variant analysis. With the analyzer, you can perform whole genome analysis of SVs down to
300bp in size—enabling insights into previously undetectable DNA variations.

][39]
[[Reliable, actionable, and easy-to-interpret data]

# Reliable, actionable, and easy-to-interpret data

Nabsys has partnered with Hitachi High Tech to develop and release the Human Chromosome Explorer™
(HCE), a suite of secondary analytical software tools that seamlessly assembles genomes and
identifies SVs according to custom parameters. The Human Chromosome Explorer puts actionable SV data
at your fingertips.

][40]

## Research Areas & Applications

OhmX enables a variety of different SV analyses based on research needs ensuring a more complete
view of the human genome.

[
Cancer Research
Gain deeper insights and drive breakthroughs in cancer research with the OhmX™ Platform,  powered by
electronic genome mapping (EGM) and expertly engineered to unravel the complexities of structural
variants (SVs) in cancer genomes.
][41][
Orthogonal Confirmation of NGS and LRS
Gain confidence in your genomic discoveries from NGS and long-read sequencing (LRS) platforms with a
low-cost solution to verify, clarify, and identify structural variant (SV) calls.
][42][
Rare Disease
Unravel complexities and gain critical insights with the OhmX™ Platform, designed to help you push
the boundaries of rare disease research.
][43][
Repeat Expansion Detection and Confirmation
Detect and confirm complex repeat expansions with the OhmX™ Platform, delivering accurate sizing and
structural insight beyond the limits of PCR and traditional sequencing methods.
][44]

## Nucleome: a deep-tech genomics enterprise

When Standard Tests Fail, 4Power WGS HiFi Delivers Answers. Contact us now to resolve the unresolved
rare disease and complex cancer cases.

## Empowering Precision Genomics for a Healthier Future

#### Genomics

Nucleome Informatics offers de novo genome sequencing, resequencing, and targeted resequencing for
variant detection. Our clinical genetic testing identifies pathogenic markers for diagnosis and
personalized treatment. Using next-generation sequencing and bioinformatics, we deliver actionable
genomic insights for researchers, clinicians, and biotech innovators.

[View More][57]

#### Epigenomics

Nucleome Informatics provides ChIP-Seq, WGBS, methylation arrays, and PacBio HiFi sequencing for
epigenetic analysis. We profile protein-DNA interactions, DNA methylation, and chromatin
accessibility. Our bioinformatics solutions deliver insights into gene regulation, disease
mechanisms, and epigenetic inheritance for health and environmental research.

[View More][58]

#### Metagenomics

Nucleome Informatics offers Shotgun metagenome, 16S rRNA, fungal ITS, and metatranscriptome
sequencing using PacBio HiFi and Illumina. We profile microbial communities, generate metagenome
assembled genomes, and study epigenetic modifications, supporting clinical and environmental
research with detailed microbial diversity insights.

[View More][59]

#### Transcriptomics

Nucleome Informatics sequences Total RNA, mRNA, lncRNA, and miRNA, using Iso-Seq and single-cell RNA
sequencing. We characterize isoforms, gene expression, and cellular heterogeneity. Our
bioinformatics supports discoveries in health, agriculture, and environmental genomics with precise
transcriptomic insights.

[View More][60]

#### Advanced Long Read Genomics

Nucleome Informatics, South Asia’s first PacBio Sequel II and Revio service provider, offers
high-throughput HiFi sequencing for genome assembly, variant detection, and epigenetic profiling.
Our services include PureTarget panels, Kinnex transcriptomes, and 16S rRNA analysis, delivering
comprehensive genomic insights with expert bioinformatics.

[View More][61]

#### Bioinformatics

Nucleome Informatics provides bioinformatics for genomics, analyzing sequencing data for variant
detection, transcriptomics, metagenomics, and epigenomics. Using AI and ML, we deliver clinical
reporting and actionable insights for oncology, rare diseases, agriculture, and environmental
health, empowering precision medicine and research.

[View More][62]

Harnessing genomics to accelerate discoveries in agriculture, livestock, and microbiome research.
Specialized in trait discovery, pathogen resistance, microbial diversity, and ecosystem health.
Providing sequencing, bioinformatics, and AI-driven insights for sustainable innovation. [View
More][63]
**DrSeq-Human Genomics and Genetic testing** [DrSeq][64] is a clinical genomics lab by Nucleome
Informatics. We offer a wide range of services in human genome sequencing, clinical exome
sequencing, pharmacogenomics, rare diseases, reproductive health, eye disorders and more. [View
More][65]

## Empowering Precision Genomics for a Healthier Future

#### Genomics

Nucleome Informatics offers de novo genome sequencing, resequencing, and targeted resequencing for
variant detection. Our clinical genetic testing identifies pathogenic markers for diagnosis and
personalized treatment. Using next-generation sequencing and bioinformatics, we deliver actionable
genomic insights for researchers, clinicians, and biotech innovators.

#### Epigenomics

Nucleome Informatics provides ChIP-Seq, WGBS, methylation arrays, and PacBio HiFi sequencing for
epigenetic analysis. We profile protein-DNA interactions, DNA methylation, and chromatin
accessibility. Our bioinformatics solutions deliver insights into gene regulation, disease
mechanisms, and epigenetic inheritance for health and environmental research.

[View More][58]

#### Metagenomics

Nucleome Informatics offers Shotgun metagenome, 16S rRNA, fungal ITS, and metatranscriptome
sequencing using PacBio HiFi and Illumina. We profile microbial communities, generate metagenome
assembled genomes, and study epigenetic modifications, supporting clinical and environmental
research with detailed microbial diversity insights.

[View More][59]

#### Transcriptomics

Nucleome Informatics sequences Total RNA, mRNA, lncRNA, and miRNA, using Iso-Seq and single-cell RNA
sequencing. We characterize isoforms, gene expression, and cellular heterogeneity. Our
bioinformatics supports discoveries in health, agriculture, and environmental genomics with precise
transcriptomic insights.

comprehensive genomic insights with expert bioinformatics.

detection, transcriptomics, metagenomics, and epigenomics. Using AI and ML, we deliver clinical

health, empowering precision medicine and research.

scientific discovery.

###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

strategic growth platforms.

# Fostering Collaboration to ** Accelerate Discoveries [ decorative line element] **

A premier center for genomic research, the New York Genome Center (NYGC) fosters collaboration among
leading scientists from multiple institutions to accelerate genomic discoveries and their
translation into new therapies and diagnostics.

## Dr. Bing Ren Appointed Scientific Director and CEO of NYGC[short decorative line element]

We are proud to announce Bing Ren, PhD, as the new Scientific Director and CEO of the New York
Genome Center.

Dr. Ren brings his expertise in the fields of genomics and epigenetics to the NYGC and Columbia
University, where he will hold a joint appointment as a professor in the Departments of Genetics and
Development, Biochemistry and Molecular Biophysics, and Systems Biology and as the associate
director of the Roy and Diana Vagelos Institute for Basic Biomedical Science within the Vagelos
College of Physicians and Surgeons.

## Shared Stories of Success[short decorative line element]

## Shared Stories of Success[short decorative line element]

[quote icon]

It is a dream job for me to join the New York Genome Center and Columbia University,” said Dr. Ren.
“Decoding the human genome and using this knowledge to improve health has been a lifelong pursuit of
mine. Bringing the fruits of genomic research into clinical care will require unprecedented
collaboration and innovation. I look forward to achieving this goal by leveraging NYGC’s fantastic
genomics infrastructure, exceptionally rich talent pool, and close associations with its
institutional founding members in New York.”

[Learn more about Dr. Bing Ren][84]
Bing Ren, PhD Scientific Director & CEO Professor of Genetics and Development, Biochemistry and
Molecular Biophysics, and Systems Biology, Associate Director in the Vagelos Institute for Basic
Biomedical Science (Vagelos Institute) in VP&S, Columbia University

## Shared Stories of Success[short decorative line element]

[quote icon]

Studying the changes in gene expression we see in each stage of ALS is key to identifying what
triggers symptom onset. Our work with Target ALS ensures we maintain productive collaborations with
ALS researchers to develop life-changing treatments.”

[Read more on NYGC’s work with Target ALS and New York State.][85]

[Click here to learn more about the Phatnani Lab.][86]
[Hemali Phatnani headshot]
Hemali Phatnani Director, Center for Genomics of Neurodegenerative Disease, NYGC Assistant Professor
of Neurological Sciences (in Neurology), Columbia University

## Shared Stories of Success[short decorative line element]

[quote icon]

We’re now entering an era of low-cost DNA sequencing, and in this study, we took advantage of that
to apply whole-genome sequencing techniques that in the past would have been considered wildly
impractical.”

[Read more on the latest study from the Landau Lab][87]
[Dan Landau headshot]
Dan Landau, MD, PhD Core Faculty Member, NYGC Professor of Medicine, Division of Hematology and
Medical Oncology; Professor of Physiology and Biophysics, Weill Cornell Medicine

## In Memoriam:
## Dr. Thomas Lehner,
## Pioneer in Neuropsychiatric Disease Research[short decorative line element]

August 29, 1960 – November 6, 2024

Dr. Lehner was a visionary in the field of neuropsychiatric disease research. A champion of open
science and collaboration, Dr. Lehner was a respected leader in the study of the genetic
underpinnings of neuropsychiatric disorders such as, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, autism, and
Alzheimer’s disease. His legacy of scientific innovation and collaboration will continue to inspire
generations to come.

## Innovative Technology Platforms[short decorative line element]

Our multidisciplinary team of scientists, engineers, and NYGC faculty come together to explore and
test innovative genomic tools and technologies to drive progress within our center and the broader
scientific community.

[Two scientists view a screen that indicates sequencing complete]

## Clinical Genetics[short decorative line element]

The New York Genome Center has a state-of-the-art clinical diagnostic laboratory that utilizes
next-generation sequencing technology to perform cutting-edge tests in the areas of genetics and
oncology. The Clinical Laboratory is accredited by the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments
(CLIA) and the Clinical Laboratory Evaluation Program of the New York State Department of Health
(CLEP). It is licensed to perform clinical testing in all fifty (50) of the United States and the
District of Columbia. The laboratory participates in the College of American Pathologists (CAP)
proficiency testing.

# Fostering Collaboration to ** Accelerate Discoveries [ decorative line element] **

A premier center for genomic research, the New York Genome Center (NYGC) fosters collaboration among
leading scientists from multiple institutions to accelerate genomic discoveries and their
translation into new therapies and diagnostics.

## Dr. Bing Ren Appointed Scientific Director and CEO of NYGC[short decorative line element]

We are proud to announce Bing Ren, PhD, as the new Scientific Director and CEO of the New York
Genome Center.

Dr. Ren brings his expertise in the fields of genomics and epigenetics to the NYGC and Columbia
University, where he will hold a joint appointment as a professor in the Departments of Genetics and
Development, Biochemistry and Molecular Biophysics, and Systems Biology and as the associate
director of the Roy and Diana Vagelos Institute for Basic Biomedical Science within the Vagelos
College of Physicians and Surgeons.

## In Memoriam:
## Dr. Thomas Lehner,
## Pioneer in Neuropsychiatric Disease Research[short decorative line element]

August 29, 1960 – November 6, 2024

Dr. Lehner was a visionary in the field of neuropsychiatric disease research. A champion of open
science and collaboration, Dr. Lehner was a respected leader in the study of the genetic
underpinnings of neuropsychiatric disorders such as, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, autism, and
Alzheimer’s disease. His legacy of scientific innovation and collaboration will continue to inspire
generations to come.

## Clinical Genetics[short decorative line element]

The New York Genome Center has a state-of-the-art clinical diagnostic laboratory that utilizes
next-generation sequencing technology to perform cutting-edge tests in the areas of genetics and
oncology. The Clinical Laboratory is accredited by the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments
(CLIA) and the Clinical Laboratory Evaluation Program of the New York State Department of Health
(CLEP). It is licensed to perform clinical testing in all fifty (50) of the United States and the
District of Columbia. The laboratory participates in the College of American Pathologists (CAP)
proficiency testing.

### Featured Products - See our favorites

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

### Featured Products - See our favorites

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

operational and R&D excellence.”

## Our mission in action

[
[Two colleagues sit on a green couch in a modern office, engaged in conversation. One person
gestures while speaking, and the other listens attentively with a slight smile.]
Prevent

### Identifying high-risk patients

We prevent diseases by identifying high-risk patients early to enable timely use of medicines.

Our strategy
][110]
[

research in a lab setting.]
Stop

### Halting disease progression

We stop disease progression by accurately diagnosing patients and delivering targeted medicines.

Our diagnostics solutions

[A laboratory professional wearing glasses and gloves explains a piece of equipment to a colleague
while holding its open lid in a lab setting.]
Cure

### Restoring health through medicines

We cure diseases by identifying the cause of a patient’s condition and restoring health through
curative medicines.

Our pharma solutions

# KREX Technology:
# Redefining Antibody Profiling

Unlock actionable insights, from biomarkers to therapies

[Explore applications][87]

## The ultimate platform for high-plex antibody profiling

**KREX™ technology** is the only high-plex antibody profiling solution designed to deliver
reproducible insights into the immunoproteome with unmatched precision. Its unique combination of
advanced features enable:
* **Correctly folded proteins**: preserves critical protein structures, recognized by 90% of
  antibodies, to ensure biologically relevant interactions
* **Mean CV <10%**: ensures consistent results across replicate protein spots, enabling confident
  data interpretation and analysis
* **FDR <1%**: reduces false positives, enhancing data precision for meaningful and trustworthy
  discoveries
* **High sensitivity and wide dynamic range**: picomolar (pM) sensitivity with a linear range across
  5 logs
* **Dual isotype analysis**: simultaneous insights into two antibody isotypes (IgG, IgA, IgM)

[See how KREX works][88]

### Identify and validate biomarker signatures with confidence

**KREX technology** enables high-multiplex profiling of antibodies against thousands of proteins,

biology

### Understand disease mechanisms with precision antibody profiling

**KREX technology** reveals the antibody-based immune response to molecular disease processes,
enabling identification of protein antigens, protective antibodies and pathogenic antibodies linked
to disease onset, progression and severity. These insights uncover disease-driving pathways, improve
understanding of host-pathogen interactions, and accelerate the development of new diagnostics and
therapies.

[Talk to an expert][90]

Drug
screening
[Image of biomarkers]

### Screen immunotherapy drug targets rapidly and efficiently

Characterizing the specificity and off-target binding of antibody-based drugs is critical for
ensuring safety and efficacy. **KREX technology** enables high-throughput screening, empowering you
to evaluate drug interactions across thousands of correctly folded proteins. By identifying optimal
targets and minimizing off-target effects, KREX technology accelerates the development of safer,
more effective immunotherapies.

[Talk to an expert][91]

Vaccine
development
[Image of scientist working with lab samples - representing vaccine development]

### Streamline vaccine development with advanced antibody profiling

**KREX technology** delivers actionable insights across every stage of vaccine development – from
identifying antigens to optimizing dosing and delivery. By profiling antibodies against thousands of
correctly folded proteins, KREX accelerates timelines, reduces costs and supports the design of
safer, more effective vaccines.

[Talk to an expert][92]

Post-translational
modifications
[Image of scientist holding various lab samples]

### Study the immune response to citrullinated proteins

Explore the immune response to inflammation and cellular damage with our exclusive **Citrullination
Assay**. Compatible with select KREX microarrays, this assay enables highly multiplexed and
sensitive detection of autoantibodies targeting citrullinated proteins – key players in diseases
such as rheumatoid arthritis, neurodegenerative disorders and cancer. By integrating the
Citrullination Assay into KREX technology, you can uncover disease-specific biomarkers, gain deeper
insights into immune response mechanisms and drive therapeutic development.

[Talk to an expert][93]

Bioinformatics
 

### Expert data analysis support for antibody biomarker research

Our bioinformatics experts provide tailored, comprehensive support – from study design to
multivariate modeling – to transform your results into meaningful discoveries. Using advanced
algorithms and machine learning, we enable *de novo* patient stratification, integrate experimental
and clinical data, and conduct detailed biological pathway analysis. This flexible and customized
approach empowers you to uncover novel insights into disease mechanisms, immune responses and
therapeutic targets.

# KREX Technology:
# Redefining Antibody Profiling

Unlock actionable insights, from biomarkers to therapies

[Explore applications][87]

## The ultimate platform for high-plex antibody profiling

**KREX™ technology** is the only high-plex antibody profiling solution designed to deliver
reproducible insights into the immunoproteome with unmatched precision. Its unique combination of
advanced features enable:
* **Correctly folded proteins**: preserves critical protein structures, recognized by 90% of
  antibodies, to ensure biologically relevant interactions
* **Mean CV <10%**: ensures consistent results across replicate protein spots, enabling confident
  data interpretation and analysis
* **FDR <1%**: reduces false positives, enhancing data precision for meaningful and trustworthy
  discoveries
* **High sensitivity and wide dynamic range**: picomolar (pM) sensitivity with a linear range across
  5 logs
* **Dual isotype analysis**: simultaneous insights into two antibody isotypes (IgG, IgA, IgM)

### Identify and validate biomarker signatures with confidence

**KREX technology** enables high-multiplex profiling of antibodies against thousands of proteins,
uncovering actionable biomarkers for early diagnosis, molecular subtyping, risk management and
beyond – driving progress in precision medicine.

[Talk to an expert][89]

Disease
biology
[Image of antibodies]

### Understand disease mechanisms with precision antibody profiling

**KREX technology** reveals the antibody-based immune response to molecular disease processes,
enabling identification of protein antigens, protective antibodies and pathogenic antibodies linked
to disease onset, progression and severity. These insights uncover disease-driving pathways, improve
understanding of host-pathogen interactions, and accelerate the development of new diagnostics and
therapies.

[Talk to an expert][90]

Drug
screening
[Image of biomarkers]

### Screen immunotherapy drug targets rapidly and efficiently

Characterizing the specificity and off-target binding of antibody-based drugs is critical for
ensuring safety and efficacy. **KREX technology** enables high-throughput screening, empowering you
to evaluate drug interactions across thousands of correctly folded proteins. By identifying optimal
targets and minimizing off-target effects, KREX technology accelerates the development of safer,
more effective immunotherapies.

[Talk to an expert][91]

Vaccine
development
[Image of scientist working with lab samples - representing vaccine development]

### Streamline vaccine development with advanced antibody profiling

**KREX technology** delivers actionable insights across every stage of vaccine development – from
identifying antigens to optimizing dosing and delivery. By profiling antibodies against thousands of
correctly folded proteins, KREX accelerates timelines, reduces costs and supports the design of
safer, more effective vaccines.

[Talk to an expert][92]

Post-translational
modifications
[Image of scientist holding various lab samples]

### Study the immune response to citrullinated proteins

Explore the immune response to inflammation and cellular damage with our exclusive **Citrullination
Assay**. Compatible with select KREX microarrays, this assay enables highly multiplexed and
sensitive detection of autoantibodies targeting citrullinated proteins – key players in diseases
such as rheumatoid arthritis, neurodegenerative disorders and cancer. By integrating the
Citrullination Assay into KREX technology, you can uncover disease-specific biomarkers, gain deeper
insights into immune response mechanisms and drive therapeutic development.

[Talk to an expert][93]

Bioinformatics
 

### Expert data analysis support for antibody biomarker research

Our bioinformatics experts provide tailored, comprehensive support – from study design to
multivariate modeling – to transform your results into meaningful discoveries. Using advanced
algorithms and machine learning, we enable *de novo* patient stratification, integrate experimental
and clinical data, and conduct detailed biological pathway analysis. This flexible and customized
approach empowers you to uncover novel insights into disease mechanisms, immune responses and
therapeutic targets.

## Comprehensive Genetic Testing + Consultation

The only provider in the world to combine Long/Short Read Whole Genome Sequencing with Bionano
Optical Genome Mapping and Transcriptome Sequencing. Our [upgradeable testing architecture][16]
saves patients and providers time and money.

Find the Right Test[Download our Brochures][17][Test Portfolio][18][Schedule Consultation][19]

NewsDr. Peter Nagy gives talk on Accelerating Prenatal Diagnostics!

Despite costly and extensive testing, **nearly 50% of patients** with an underlying genetic disease
never receive a molecular diagnosis.

Even with breakthroughs that tailor each patient's treatment to their cancer's unique genetic
profile, **fewer than 10% of cancer patients** undergo such testing.

We created Praxis Genomics to overcome these fundamental limitations in genetic diagnostics.

### Our Unique Approach

As the only provider with a [test portfolio][21] combining these three technologies, we investigate
the genome at sequence, structure, and function levels simultaneously. We apply to this approach a
unique [upgradeable testing architecture][22] that saves patients and providers time and money.

🔬

Saphyr Whole Genome Optical Mapping Instrument

The Saphyr® Whole Genome Optical Mapping Instrument from Bionano Genomics provides a high level
assessment of breaks, rearrangements and repeat expansions in the DNA that cannot be seen using
sequencing

[Bionano Sequencing Machine]
[Illumina Novaseq 6000 System]

DNBSEQ-T7

DNBSEQ-T7 can generate 1-7Tb of high-quality data per day for a wide range of applications,
including whole genome, deep exome, epigenome, transcriptome, and targeted panel sequencing
projects.

[ Learn About DNBSEQ-T7 ][41]

NovaSeq 6000 System

The NovaSeq 6000 Sequencing System allows diagnosis of DNA mutations at the level of its building
blocks

[ Learn About NovaSeq 6000 ][42]

The PromethION sequencer allows diagnosis of DNA mutations that scale between the building block
resolution and the high level assessment.

The minION combines long read sequencing technology with rapid data availability for fast variant
confirmation.

[ Learn About minION ][44]

The Dragen analysis pipeline allows high sensitivity detection of mutations and instability in
difficult to analyze repetitive regions

## About Us

TT Instruments® is the trading name of TechPlant Ltd, an ISO-certified UK company supplying
precision test and measurement equipment worldwide. Our team of tech enthusiasts is dedicated to
excellence, offering in-stock products at competitive prices and outstanding customer service. Since
starting as a small eBay shop in 2021, we have grown to include an in-house lab, photography
facilities, and secure storage. We focus on clear communication, reliable service, and continuous
improvement to ensure every customer is satisfied and their expectations are exceeded.

## About Us

TT Instruments® is the trading name of TechPlant Ltd, an ISO-certified UK company supplying
precision test and measurement equipment worldwide. Our team of tech enthusiasts is dedicated to
excellence, offering in-stock products at competitive prices and outstanding customer service. Since
starting as a small eBay shop in 2021, we have grown to include an in-house lab, photography
facilities, and secure storage. We focus on clear communication, reliable service, and continuous
improvement to ensure every customer is satisfied and their expectations are exceeded.
